source: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker Application Guide

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Canadian Language Benchmarks (CLB) or NCLC Level 5 or higher for jobs in NOC TEER 0, 1, 2, and 3 (Skilled Worker, Critical Construction Worker and Occupations in Demand categories)

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: An approved language test showing at least CLB/NCLC 4 is mandatory for jobs in NOC TEER 4 and 5, issued within two years of the NSNP submission

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: 12 complete calendar months of paid work within the last 5 years and a minimum of 1,560 hours, related to the job being offered (volunteer work and unpaid internships do not count)

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: employer
requirements.label: The employer must have operated in Nova Scotia for at least 2 years

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Before you submit an EOI to the Skilled Worker stream, find out if you need a licence or certificate to do the job you have been offered
requirements.section: You may need a licence or certificate for the job you have been offered

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream — Skilled Worker category
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: You have a high school diploma

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream — Critical Construction Worker category
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: You have a high school diploma OR proof you have completed a construction specific industry training program
requirements.section: B) Critical Construction Workers — Education Requirements - CCW

requirements.stream: NSNP Skilled Worker stream — Physician sub-criteria
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You have received an approved job offer from the NSH or IWK in one of these National Occupational Classifications (NOC)
requirements.label: Approved job offer from Nova Scotia Health (NSH) or the IWK in NOC 31100, 31101 or 31102

requirements.stream: NSNP Skilled Worker stream — Physician sub-criteria
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You commit to live and work in Nova Scotia for at least 2 years
requirements.label: Commit to live and work in Nova Scotia for at least 2 years

requirements.stream: NSNP Skilled Worker stream — Physician sub-criteria
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You have a valid Education credential assessment from the Medical Council of Canada OR proof that you meet all the criteria required to obtain a licence to practise medicine in Nova Scotia from the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Nova Scotia
requirements.label: Education credential assessment from the Medical Council of Canada, or proof of meeting the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Nova Scotia licensing criteria

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Graduate stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: prove language ability equal to Canadian Language Benchmark (CLB) Level 5
requirements.label: Canadian Language Benchmark (CLB) Level 5 (Nova Scotia Graduate stream)

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Graduate stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have certifications issued by NS regulatory bodies required for the job
requirements.label: Certifications issued by Nova Scotia regulatory bodies required for the job

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Graduate stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have met requirements for completing a program of study at an eligible Nova Scotia designated learning institution within three years of your application
requirements.label: Completed a program of study at an eligible Nova Scotia designated learning institution within three years of applying

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have at least one year of experience working in Nova Scotia in an occupation at TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3 of the National Occupational Classification
requirements.label: At least 12 months (one year) of work experience in Nova Scotia in a NOC TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3 occupation
requirements.section: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia — Eligibility

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You need CLB 7 for skilled work in the National Occupational Classification (NOC) TEER 0 and 1
requirements.label: CLB 7 for NOC TEER 0 and 1 (Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia)
requirements.section: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia — Eligibility

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You need CLB 5 for NOC TEER 2 and 3 positions
requirements.label: CLB 5 for NOC TEER 2 and 3 (Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia)
requirements.section: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia — Eligibility

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have a profile registered in Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada’s Express Entry system
requirements.label: A profile registered in the federal Express Entry system
requirements.section: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia — Eligibility

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Physicians
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have an approved opportunity from the NSHA or IWK as either a general practitioner and family physician (NOC 31102) or a specialist physician (NOC 31100 and NOC 31101)
requirements.label: Approved opportunity from the NSHA or IWK as a general practitioner / family physician (NOC 31102) or specialist physician (NOC 31100, 31101)
requirements.section: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Physicians — Eligibility

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Physicians
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: provide a copy of a signed Return for Service Agreement with the Nova Scotia Department of Health and Wellness indicating commitment to live and work in Nova Scotia for a minimum period of two years
requirements.label: Signed Return for Service Agreement: live and work in Nova Scotia for at least two years
requirements.section: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Physicians — Eligibility

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Physicians
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: receive a Letter of Interest from the Nova Scotia Nominee Program within the Express Entry system
requirements.label: Receive a Letter of Interest from the NSNP within the federal Express Entry system
requirements.section: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Physicians — Eligibility

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Physicians
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: meet the minimum work experience requirements of the Express Entry stream for which you have qualified
requirements.label: Meet the minimum work experience requirements of the federal Express Entry program you qualified under
requirements.section: Nova Scotia: Express Entry — Physicians — Eligibility
